newsitem.title: DUBAI: Fujairah 380-cst bunkers quoted at $95-$97 tonne.
newsitem.headline: Fujairah 380-cst bunkers quoted at $95-$97 tonne.

text.p: Fujairah 380-cst bunkers were quoted by Gulf traders on Monday at $95-97 a tonne, a $1 weaker than Friday levels but still largely resilient to weaker crude.
Traders said 180-cst material from the United Arab Emirates port was quoted at $100-$103 a tonne.
"It should be falling because of crude but it has been steady for a month because of stable Singapore cargo markets," one said.
Crude futures on Friday hit their lowest level since February 1996. Crude has lost 15 percent in value in the last three weeks and 30 percent since the start of the year.
